prompt:
Finished Instagram feed post, vertical 4:5, for Society, an AI marketing agency for bars and restaurants. The photograph and the graphic design are ONE image: an editorial food-advertising still life shot by a professional food photographer, with the headline typeset directly on the photo.

CAMERA, ANGLE AND LIGHT from reference image 1: high three-quarter view about 40 degrees above the table, 50 mm lens look, the dish in the lower-right two thirds of the frame, empty warm tabletop in the upper part to carry the headline. Hard late-afternoon sunlight raking in from the upper right, with crisp dappled leaf shadows from a potted plant falling across the table and the crust; deep warm shadows, specular highlights on oil, prosciutto fat and glass. Shallow depth of field: focus plane on the front edge of the pizza and the arugula, background props softly out of focus. Subtle real film grain. It must look photographed, never rendered.

THE DISH from reference image 2, reproduced faithfully (this is the real pizza of the restaurant Da Tonino): Neapolitan pizza prosciutto e rucola with a puffy leopard-spotted charred cornicione, bright tomato base, folds of thin pink prosciutto, a generous heap of fresh wild arugula in the centre, a few patches of melted mozzarella. It sits on the same dark terracotta round plate on a kraft paper placemat on a light wood table, as in reference 2. Next to it, upper left, the same straight pint glass of golden beer from reference 2, sunlight glowing through it. Keep only props that exist in reference 2: light wood table, kraft placemat, white paper napkin, fork and knife, small potted plant. No new food, no extra dishes.

MASCOT from references 3 and 4: the Society mascot as a small real collectible vinyl figure (about 15 cm tall) standing on the table to the left of the plate, giving a thumbs up, catching the same hard sunlight and casting a real shadow on the wood. Exact design: crumpled white paper ball head, glossy black oval face with two white vertical pill-shaped eyes (eyes never change), thin wireframe globe halo above the head, cobalt blue hoodie #1033EF with black drawstrings and a small yellow four-point sparkle on the chest, white glove hands, thin black legs, chunky white sneakers with black stripes. The mascot never covers the pizza or any text.

TYPOGRAPHY printed directly on the photograph, upper left area over the empty tabletop, layout inspired by reference 1. No boxes, no panels, no cards, no banners, no stickers, no badges, no bubbles, no shapes behind any text. Headline in three lines with tight leading: line 1 'ESTO' and line 3 'CON LOS OJOS.' in huge ultra-condensed heavy grotesque all caps in warm off-white #F2F1EC; line 2 'se come' in large high-contrast bold serif italic lowercase in yellow #F5C518, overlapping the caps slightly like a magazine cover. Bottom left, small clean grotesque off-white text in two lines: 'Fotos, posts y reels para tu bar.' and below it 'Hechos con IA. Parecen de estudio.'. Very small monospace off-white text at the bottom edge: 'SOCIETY · LINK EN LA BIO'. Very small monospace off-white text at the top right: 'Prosciutto e rucola · Da Tonino'. Exact Spanish spelling, no other text, no logos, no watermark. A soft natural darkening of the light wood behind the headline is allowed for legibility, but no shapes.
